title: Link Click Season 3 Part 1
native: 时光代理人 第三季 Part One
synopsis:
After the Li Tianchen case comes to a close, peace appears to return to Time Photo Studio—until the disappearance of Xia Fei draws everyone back into a web of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's newfound abilities, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang begin uncovering the truth behind the mysterious Bahati fire.

As the investigation deepens, hidden connections emerge between the case and Cheng Xiaoshi's parents. Meanwhile, Liu Xiao, a member of a mysterious organization, sets his own plans in motion, while the intervention of Inspector Jae introduces new uncertainties. As secrets buried in the past resurface, the search for truth becomes more dangerous than ever.

(Source: bilibili, translated)
